description: This file contains utility functions used for object detection tasks, including evaluation, bounding box correction, non-max suppression, neural network output decoding, input preprocessing, and overlap computations, specific to a custom YOLO-based detection pipeline.

methods.name: _sigmoid(x)
methods.description: Applies the sigmoid (expit) function to input x.

methods.name: makedirs(path)
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path if it does not exist.

methods.name: evaluate(model, generator, iou_threshold, obj_thresh, nms_thresh, net_h=416, net_w=416, save_path=None)
methods.description: Evaluates a detection model on a dataset to compute mean Average Precision (mAP) scores per class.

methods.name: correct_yolo_boxes(boxes, image_h, image_w, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Adjusts bounding boxes to the original image dimensions after network prediction.

methods.name: do_nms(boxes, nms_thresh)
methods.description: Performs non-maximum suppression on a list of bounding boxes to filter overlapping detections.

methods.name: decode_netout(netout, anchors, obj_thresh, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Decodes raw network output into bounding box objects with coordinates and class probabilities.

methods.name: preprocess_input(image, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Prepares an input image for the neural network: resizing, normalization, and padding.

methods.name: normalize(image)
methods.description: Normalizes image pixel values to a scale of 0 to 1.

methods.name: get_yolo_boxes(model, images, net_h, net_w, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh)
methods.description: Runs the YOLO model on images, decodes the outputs into bounding boxes, applies corrections and suppression.

methods.name: compute_overlap(a, b)
methods.description: Calculates the overlap (Intersection over Union) between two sets of bounding boxes.

methods.name: compute_ap(recall, precision)
methods.description: Computes average precision given recall and precision curves.

methods.name: _softmax(x, axis=-1)
methods.description: Computes the softmax of input array along specified axis.

ctags.name: evaluate
ctags.signature: (model, generator, iou_threshold, obj_thresh, nms_thresh, net_h=416, net_w=416, save_path=None)

ctags.name: get_yolo_boxes
ctags.pattern: /^def get_yolo_boxes(model, images, net_h, net_w, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh):$/
ctags.signature: (model, images, net_h, net_w, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh)
